segments.en: So you wanted to fly airplanes.
segments.zh: 所以你想驾驶飞机。

segments.en: Yeah, I wanted to be a jet pilot.
segments.zh: 是的，我想成为一名喷气式飞行员。

segments.en: Actually I collected books about it, I read up about it, so even till now I probably still remember like the capacity of certain jets or what types of weapons they have.
segments.zh: 实际上，我收集了有关它的书籍，我阅读了有关它的书籍，所以即使到目前为止，我可能仍然记得某些喷气式飞机的容量或它们拥有的武器类型。

segments.en: I was really, really into it.
segments.zh: 我真的，真的很喜欢它。

segments.en: Wow, I never knew this about you.
segments.zh: 哇，我从来不知道关于你的事情。

segments.en: Yeah, what about you?
segments.zh: 是的，你呢？

segments.en: I could never decide as a kid.
segments.zh: 我小时候永远无法决定。

segments.en: I remember we had to draw pictures of what I will look like in 20 years and everyone had these pictures, I will be a doctor, I'll be a veterinarian, I'll be the president.
segments.zh: 我记得我们必须画出我 20 年后的样子，每个人都有这些照片，我将成为一名医生，我将成为一名兽医，我将成为总统。

segments.en: I never knew what to draw, so I think I copied my friend, she wanted to be a lawyer.
segments.zh: 我从来不知道要画什么，所以我想我抄袭了我的朋友，她想成为一名律师。

segments.en: I was like, okay, that sounds okay.
segments.zh: 我当时想，好吧，听起来不错。

segments.en: Yeah, I think it's hard and usually what you want to be as a kid, you don't do it when you're older.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这很难，通常你小时候想成为什么，你长大后就不会这样做。

segments.en: Yeah, it's because of my vision, I didn't have 20-20 vision to actually join the Air Force.
segments.zh: 是的，这是因为我的愿景，我没有 20-20 的愿景来真正加入空军。

segments.en: Well, and a lot of kids don't know how many jobs there are out there.
segments.zh: 好吧，很多孩子不知道那里有多少工作。

segments.en: You know the big ones, doctor, lawyer, fireman, policeman, astronaut.
segments.zh: 你知道大医生、律师、消防员、警察、宇航员。

segments.en: So I guess the question for you is what's your profession?
segments.zh: 所以我想你的问题是你的职业是什么？

segments.en: Tell us about it, especially if it's one of the less famous professions out there, because there's a lot that I don't know about those.
segments.zh: 告诉我们它，特别是如果它是不那么著名的职业之一，因为我对这些职业有很多不知道的地方。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com, we hope to see you there and until next time.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 Englishpod.com，我们希望在那里见到您，直到下一次。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。
